body.label: Effect
body.html: Let the Phantom loom over one creature within 4 units. On a success, it suffers -1 Defense until its next turn and becomes Exposed.

surges.html: On a success, move the target 1 unit or prevent it from moving 1 unit on its next turn.
After this resolves, gain +1 Defense until your next turn as the entity partially overlays you.

rider.title: PHANTOM — FULL MANIFESTATION
rider.html: If you spent at least 4 dice on this Action, as it resolves you may spend 2 additional Mana to fully manifest your Phantom.
